description: The Shared Signals transmitter's poll endpoint (POST /ssf/poll, RFC 8936): a SET a receiver reported invalid in setErrs. The SET, its jti and the receiver's description are never event fields.

ssf.poll.set_error.description: A receiver reported a SET invalid in a poll's setErrs, and the SET was released; the reason is its RFC 8935 error code (invalid_request, invalid_key, invalid_issuer, invalid_audience, authentication_failed, access_denied) or other.
